items.title: AMD Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: For the second quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $11.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million. The mid-point of the revenue range represents year-over-year growth of approximately 46% and a sequential increase of approximately 9%. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be approximately 56%.

items.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: AMD said its second quarter results were impacted by the U.S. Government's export control on AMD Instinct MI308 data center GPU products, with approximately $800 million in inventory and related charges. The release also said AMD is seeing robust demand across its computing and AI product portfolio and is well positioned to deliver significant growth in the second half of the year.

items.title: AMD Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Data Center segment revenue was $4.3 billion, up 22% year-over-year primarily driven by strong demand for 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs. The release also noted the OpenAI strategic partnership and planned 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs for next-generation AI infrastructure.

items.title: May 6, 2026 - 10-Q: Quarterly report [Sections 13 or 15(d)] | Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD)
items.snippet: AMD's net revenue increased, driven by strong demand for 5th generation AMD EPYC processors and AMD Instinct MI350 Series GPUs, as well as increased Client and Gaming revenue and Embedded revenue as certain end market demand increased.
